title: AI Agent Loop Explorer
description: Input, draft, human review, send -- stepped through with the real text, and one confidently wrong detail in every draft.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: AI Agents for Registration, Scheduling, and Communication

educational.audience: Mentors introducing an AI agent to club admin

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a scenario, the learner explains what happens at each stage of an AI agent's loop and why the human-review stage cannot be skipped.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Step through four stages of three scenarios, and see what the unreviewed draft would have done
pedagogical.assessment: Explain why stage 3 cannot be automated away.
